request.style: English, acoustic folk worship, warm male vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, cello, soft background harmonies, intimate and peaceful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Long road and heavy shoulders
Dust of every mile I've known
Carried more than I could carry
Thought that I would walk alone
Then a voice beside the water
Gentle as the evening light
Calling out to all the weary
Calling me by name tonight

[Chorus]
Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened
And I will give you rest
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me
For I am gentle and humble in heart

[Verse]
Set them down, the stones I gathered
Every failure, every fear
He who made the hills and rivers
Bends to meet me, draws me near

[Chorus]
Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened
And I will give you rest
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me
For I am gentle and humble in heart

[Bridge]
My yoke is easy
My burden is light
You will find rest for your souls
Rest for your souls tonight

[Outro]
Come to me
And I will give you rest
